properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for Ensuring High-Risk Penetration Test Findings Are Remediated
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that High Risk' external penetration and vulnerability assessment issues are closed within agreed timeline.External Pentest, Web Apps Pen Test, Infra Pen Test, ASV and etc are conducted throughout a year. High Risk issue to be rectified within 1 month.
